voice: Sarcastic golf-insider voice; meme-aware; provokes thought with irony; shared joke with the reader, not at them.
philosophy: High-contrast insider commentary — black field, signal-red accent, bold type energy without luxury softness or sentimentality.
visual_philosophy: True black backgrounds (#1B1B1B), signal red (#FF3D00) accents, punchy graphic social frames; never soft pastel editorial family photography.
composition_rules: Dominant true-black field with high-contrast subject or type-safe negative space
Signal-red accent used sparingly for emphasis lines or CTA zones
One bold focal idea — meme-readable at phone scale
Insider golf context without country-club luxury staging
Crisp edges; avoid muddy gradients and fitness-magazine colour grading
anti_patterns: Luxury aesthetic and soft pastel lifestyle
Stadium-style hype and mockery aimed at the reader
Punching at handicap, age, gender, or income
Model-rendered text, watermarks, or competitor logos
people_policy: Golfers as insiders in on the joke; candid or graphic framing; never cruel or punching down.
